thesis: The podcast introduces Michael Mauboussin as the director of research at Blue Mountain Capital, highlighting his extensive career at Credit Suisse, his decade working alongside Bill Miller at Legg Mason, and his 24 years as an adjunct professor at Columbia Business School. The conversation is set to cover topics including the paradox of skill, academic research favoring active management, decision-making, team dynamics, market features, sports data analysis, career risk, and the Santa Fe Institute.
